## Study approach
Contrast with #9. Straight-line interpolation $x_t = (1-t)x_0 + t x_1$, train $v_\theta(x_t, t) \approx x_1 - x_0$, sample with an ODE solver. Straight optimal-transport paths give good samples in 10–20 Euler steps instead of 1,000.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND** — 50-line 2D flow matching on Two Moons / Swiss Roll, 3-layer MLP, Euler loop with N=5 steps vs DDPM at N=5; plot trajectories.
